thread:
Aisha (PM): FYI customer X wants BYOK + 10yr retention + per-tenant SLAs. they asked for a launch timeline by EOW.
Ben (Security): whoa 10yr is big. we need legal hold + immutability discussion. also KMS escrow asks?
Connor (Infra): technically doable as long as we have tiered archival and a retention index. cold storage cost will spike.
Eve (Solutions): customer X is enterprise-fin, they need SOC2 evidence and per-tenant audit logs with integrity proofs.
Dana (Legal): legal hold + exportability are non-negotiable. retention policy must support legal-hold overrides and export in a forensically sound format.
Frank (Eng): we should be explicit about search SLA vs retention. searching deep archives will be slow unless we index — cost tradeoff.
Aisha (PM): proposed approach: 1) BYOK handshake (manual for GA) 2) retention tiers (hot: 90d searchable, cold: up to 10y archived) 3) per-tenant SLA doc + price uplift. agree?
Ben (Security): +1 but require KMS integration checklist: key policy binding, rotation window, limited-ops access, and HSM-backed keys for gov customers. also add audit event binding to key usage.
Connor (Infra): rollout plan: alpha with 1 pilot tenant (manual ops), canary 10 tenants via feature flag, GA once automation of handshake + exports is done. timeline ~8w.
Eve (Solutions): support plan: solutions will run the first pilot and capture the full handshake log. we'll need a runbook for export and legal-hold steps.
Dana (Legal): export format: gzipped JSONL with signature header. we want chain-of-custody fields: exported_by, exported_at, key_id, signature.
Frank (Eng): quick config snippet for retention flags we'll expose:

```
retention_days: 3650
search_index: "hot/cold"
byok_enabled: true
export_format: "jsonl+sig"
```

Frank (Eng): Also need telemetry to track retention size per tenant and estimated monthly cost.
Aisha (PM): decision needed today: do we allow per-tenant custom retention > 3y on GA or gate to dedicated/private customers only?
Ben (Security): risk-adjusted: let hosted customers choose up to 3y. >3y gated to Dedicated/Private with contractual review + escrow. That reduces attack surface and legal risk.
Dana (Legal): agree. Also require customers requesting >3y to complete a data-handling questionnaire and sign SLA appendix.
Connor (Infra): operationally we can enforce policy by tenant flag and still store blobs in same backend; but billing must reflect cold-archive egress and snapshot storage.
Eve (Solutions): customer success wants a one-pager explaining tradeoffs: search latency, cost, export process, and KMS responsibilities. we'll draft.
Aisha (PM): OK, action items: Ben write KMS checklist (owner: Ben, due: 3d), Connor draft rollout steps + canary plan (owner: Connor, due: 5d), Frank add retention flags + telemetry (owner: Frank, due: 7d), Dana craft legal appendix template (owner: Dana, due: 4d), Eve produce customer one-pager (owner: Eve, due: 5d).
Ben (Security): noted. also adding requirement: key-usage audit events must retain minimum 7y for compliance.
Frank (Eng): adding a metric: retention_bytes_by_tenant and monthly_estimated_cost tag. will add to console.
Aisha (PM): timeline for GA target: 8 weeks if no major blockers. GA condition: automatic BYOK handshake, legal appendix signed, canary stable for 2 weeks, export tested.
Connor (Infra): FYI deploy-bot shows next infra freeze week in 3w. may shift schedule if heavy infra work.
deploy-bot: Reminder: infra freeze scheduled 3890015000 - 3890015600.
Eve (Solutions): quick Q — how will we price >3y? flat uplift or per-GB? sales prefers per-GB + minimum commit.
Aisha (PM): we'll propose per-GB tiered pricing + a minimum monthly commitment for >3y retention. sales to finalize.
Dana (Legal): final note: any customer-supplied keys (BYOK) must have revocation policy documented; if keys are revoked app access to old archives must be preserved via export process.
Aisha (PM): thanks team. I'll update the roadmap ticket and loop Sales for pricing. syncing again Fri 11am. :thumbsup:
Frank (Eng): I'll open the feature-flag PR and link the canary playbook.
Ben (Security): I'll start the KMS checklist doc and ping infra for required IAM roles.
Connor (Infra): prepping canary infra diagram.
Eve (Solutions): I'll schedule the pilot onboarding with customer X next Tue.
Dana (Legal): I'll draft the appendix and share for review.
Aisha (PM): closing this thread, moving decisions into the roadmap epic. thanks everyone. :rocket:
